name: Should I hire separate specialty contractors or a general remodeling service for interior repairs?

mainEntity.name: Should I hire separate specialty contractors or a general remodeling service for interior repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Homeowners often decide between an all-in-one general remodeling contractor and separate specialty trade professionals. Hiring individual drywallers, painters, and finish carpenters requires managing multiple schedules, multiple service calls, and overlapping responsibilities. Working with an owner-operated general contractor like HH Remodeling provides a single point of contact who leads the framing, drywall, and finish carpentry on site while directly scheduling any needed sub-trades for wiring or plumbing. This coordinated approach prevents delays between demolition, structural work, and final cosmetic painting.
acceptedAnswer.description: A general remodeling service provides a single point of contact who manages framing, drywall, paint, and sub-trades together, avoiding scheduling conflicts.
